digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and configuration
propositions: Current model selection inverts off equality tests against the default provider, causing silent loss of per-pass downgrades when non-default providers are used
Plan-review Pass-1 finders resolve to bare Anthropic model names that bypass provider configuration, creating split-brain behavior on Bedrock runs
A single REBAR_LLM_MODEL scalar cannot express per-tier model mappings across multiple passes and providers
Configuration layering via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must deep-merge tables and replace arrays wholesale to avoid forcing operators to restate entire config blocks

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must be resolved through three distinct call sites (resolve_model, ladder expansion, verifier paths) to ensure ladders and verifiers do not receive unresolved class strings
Model class configuration must support per-provider dispatch with fallback chains and must survive crossing provider boundaries within a single gate run
